title: GTA 6 Reviews: Metacritic 99 and What Critics Loved (and Didn't)
desc: GTA 6 scored 99 on Metacritic, tying Ocarina of Time for the highest score ever. Here's the review roundup, the top scores and the few complaints.
lead: Grand Theft Auto VI didn't just review well. It landed on the very top of Metacritic's all-time list.
sections: The score

On PlayStation 5, GTA 6 holds a 99 Metascore from roughly 144–150 critic reviews. That ties The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest Metascore of all time. The Xbox Series X|S version also shows 99, from fewer reviews. On OpenCritic the Top Critic Average sits at 98–99, with nearly every critic recommending it.
Who gave it what

IGN and GameSpot both gave it a perfect 10/10, and Eurogamer and GamesRadar+ reportedly gave 5/5. The lowest major score reported is a 9/10, so there isn't a single negative review among the big outlets.
What critics loved
The size and detail of Leonida, the Jason and Lucia relationship at the heart of the story, and how alive Vice City feels came up again and again.
The complaints
Some reviewers noted that a few long-running Rockstar habits remain, like tightly scripted missions. Performance is capped at 30 FPS on every console (see our performance comparison).
Should you buy it?
If the scores matter to you, few games in history have scored higher. Check the price in your currency and our beginner guides before you start.
seo: GTA 6 Reviews: Metacritic Score & What Critics Said

title: GTA 6 Sales: $3.79 Billion on Day One, the Biggest Launch Ever
desc: Take-Two estimates GTA 6 made about $3.79 billion on launch day with 32.5 million copies sold before release. Here's what the numbers mean.
lead: GTA 6 is now the biggest entertainment launch in history, bigger than any movie or album.
sections: The official number

Take-Two (Rockstar's parent company) estimates about $3.79 billion in global retail sales through the end of launch day, 19 November 2026, with 32.5 million copies sold before launch. These are the company's own estimates, not audited revenue.
The outside estimate
Analytics firm Sensor Tower put day one lower, at around 24.6 million digital copies and about $2.36 billion, including pre-orders. The two numbers measure different things, so both can be right.
How it compares
For comparison, GTA 5 made about $800 million in its first day back in 2013. GTA 6 roughly quadrupled that and beat every movie opening weekend ever recorded.
What it means for players
Huge sales mean Rockstar will keep supporting the game for years. The open questions are when GTA 6 Online and the PC version arrive.
seo: GTA 6 Sales: $3.79 Billion Day One Record

title: GTA 6 on PS5 vs PS5 Pro vs Xbox Series X|S: Which Runs Best?
desc: GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on every console. PS5 Pro holds it best at about 1440p upscaled, PS5 and Series X tie, and Xbox Series S renders at 720p.
lead: Every version of GTA 6 targets 30 frames per second, but they don't all hold it equally well. Here's the short version of Digital Foundry's testing.
sections: 🥇 PS5 Pro: best
Holds around 30 FPS almost all the time (brief dips to about 24 FPS in big explosions), at about 1440p upscaled with PSSR. The sharpest and steadiest version.
🥈 PS5 and Xbox Series X: tied
Around 1440p, with frame rates between 30 and the high 20s in combat and fast driving, and occasional drops into the low 20s. Series X has a tiny smoothness edge thanks to 120Hz VRR.
🥉 Xbox Series S: weakest
Renders at 720p upscaled to about 1080p, with drops to around 20 FPS in heavy scenes and lower-quality lighting, shadows and textures. Still playable, but clearly behind.
Any 60 FPS mode?
No. There's no performance mode on any console at launch, and the first patch didn't change that (see our patch notes). PC is still unannounced (PC status).

What's fixed

Several crashes (Rockstar didn't say which), story phone calls that didn't trigger and could block progress, autosave problems, weather getting stuck for long periods, and a Wanted Level you couldn't lose. Some outlets also list a gym deadlift fix and a partner loot-bag fix.

If you see error CE-108255-1, install the update, keep your console's system software updated, and rebuild the database from Safe Mode if it continues. Always save manually before big missions.

title: GTA 6 Criminal Profile Explained: Professional to Irredeemable
desc: How GTA 6's Criminal Profile works: the five states, what pushes you toward Psycho, how to stay Professional, the cracked icon warning and the permanent.
lead: GTA 6 quietly watches how Jason and Lucia commit crimes, not just whether they do. The Criminal Profile grades your style, gives Focus bonuses to match it, and can lock you into a permanent state if you go too far. Here's how it works.
sections: The five states

Guides based on the released game list five states: Professional (clean, quiet, non-lethal), Hardened (uses force when spotted), Violent (attacks cops and civilians), Psycho (extreme, pointless violence) and Irredeemable (a permanent lock). Some sites call the second state "Aggressive", so you may see both names.
What pushes you toward Psycho

Killing cops, hurting civilians (especially ones running away or defenceless), killing pets or vulnerable animals and causing unnecessary destruction all move the profile up. Threats, like holding up a store clerk, and self-defence don't count against you, and a clean robbery isn't punished by itself.
How to stay Professional

Avoid violence unless you're threatened, stay undetected, use non-lethal takedowns and only do what the job needs. The good news: Hardened, Violent and even Psycho can be walked back by playing cleaner for a while.
The cracked icon: your last warning
If your Psycho icon starts to crack, stop. It's the warning before Irredeemable. Sources disagree on how many warning stages there are, so treat any crack as the final one.
Irredeemable is permanent

Once the profile hits Irredeemable it doesn't come back in normal play, and it affects both characters. One guide says the only fix is loading a save from before it happened, so keep a manual save before you go on a rampage.
What it changes

Each style earns Focus differently: quiet players get it for non-lethal takedowns, violent players for headshots. Psycho players reportedly can't surrender to police. GTABase says the profile plays a part in which ending you get, but exact story effects aren't fully confirmed yet. Jason and Lucia have separate profiles, but their actions affect each other when they're together.

Need cheats to clean up the mess? See our cheats guide (cheats turn off saving, so save first) and track everything in the 100% tracker.
seo: GTA 6 Criminal Profile Explained (All States)

title: GTA 6 Hidden Controls: Tricks the Game Never Explains
desc: GTA 6 hidden controls for PS5 and Xbox: flip a car back over, sit anywhere, the vehicle menu, WAiNK car scanning, push boats into the water, slide over.
lead: GTA 6 has a huge control scheme and the tutorial skips a lot of it. These are the most useful hidden controls, with PS5 and Xbox buttons (default layout).
sections: Flip a car back on its wheels

Car upside down? Walk up to its side and hold Square / X to push it over. It can fail if the car is too heavy, you run out of stamina or you're on a steep slope. The same move shoves a boat or jet ski off the sand into the water.
Sit or rest anywhere
Hold Circle / B on foot to sit on grass or sand, lean against a wall or rest. A quick tap of the same button crouches instead.
The vehicle controls menu
Hold D-pad Left in a car to open the vehicle menu: engine off/on, hazard lights, trunk and windows. It's new to the series.
Scan cars with WAiNK
Hold D-pad Up to open the WAiNK app, then hold R1 / RB to scan a vehicle and see its class, whether it's locked and whether it's tracked. Handy before you steal something hot.
Duck from the cops
In a car, hold Circle / B to duck down and stay out of sight.
Slide over the hood
Run at a car and press X / A to slide over the hood. Press X / A right after climbing to chain jumps.
Throw things
R2 / RT throws the object you're holding, yes, including at people.
Talk back to Leonida
R1 / RB flips someone off, clicking the right stick yells at pedestrians and drivers, and holding L2 / LT whistles to get attention. Bike riders can bunnyhop with Circle / B.
Classic layout
Miss the old GTA controls? There are three control schemes in the settings. Classic swaps Run and Crouch back to how older games played.

title: Do You Need to Finish GTA 6's Story to Play GTA 6 Online? (Fact Check)
desc: No. The viral claim that GTA 6 Online needs 100% story completion came from a satirical account. Here's what Rockstar has actually said about GTA 6 Online.
lead: A post claiming Rockstar will lock GTA 6 Online until you finish 100% of the story (every stranger mission and collectible) went viral this week. It isn't true. Here's what's real.
sections: The rumor

The post said Rockstar 'confirmed' that players need 100% single-player completion, including all side missions and collectibles, before they can join GTA 6 Online servers. It spread fast on X and in YouTube comments.
Where it came from
Mashable traced the claim to a satirical account. Rockstar Games and Take-Two have announced no such requirement, and no official source mentions one.
Is GTA 6 Online out?
No. GTA 6 launched on 19 November 2026 as a single-player game, with no online mode at launch. Rockstar has not given a release date or window for GTA 6 Online yet.
What about 2027?
You'll see '2027' in a lot of videos. That timing comes from industry talk and reporting, not from a Rockstar announcement, so treat it as a guess until Rockstar confirms.
What you can do now
Enjoy the story at your own pace. Use our mission walkthrough, the cheat codes and the 100% tracker. We'll update our GTA 6 Online release date page the moment Rockstar announces anything.
seo: GTA 6 Online: Do You Need to Finish the Story?

title: GTA 6 Movie & TV References: Scarface, Dexter, Fast & Furious and More
desc: Every confirmed movie and TV reference players have found in GTA 6 so far: the Scarface motel room, Dexter's apartment, Brian O'Conner's Eclipse, Miami Vice.
lead: Rockstar has always filled GTA with nods to classic films, and Leonida is no exception. These are the movie and TV references players have found so far, with where to look. No story spoilers.
sections: Scarface: the motel room

The most famous one. An Ocean Beach motel room, Apartment 3C, recreates Scarface's infamous hotel scene, right down to the chainsaw in the bathtub. (Some guides also claim a Scarface-style mansion on Starfish Island, but that isn't confirmed yet.)
Dexter: Trinity Apartments
Near the top of Washington Island in Vice City, Trinity Apartments nods to Dexter's Trinity Killer, and the building looks a lot like Dexter's own apartment.
Fast & Furious: Brian's Eclipse
A green 1995 Mitsubishi-style Eclipse sits in a garage on Vespucci Island, a nod to the car Brian O'Conner drove in the first film.
Miami Vice, Heat and Goodfellas
A Rockstar developer named Miami Vice, Heat and Goodfellas as touchstones for the game, and you can feel it: players spotted an outfit that makes Jason look a lot like Miami Vice's Sonny Crockett.
Smaller nods players reported

A 'trunk shot' from inside a car (a classic Tarantino/Pulp Fiction camera angle), a Collateral-style taxi ride, a Top Gun joke in the map name Goose Key, an X-Files trophy and a Seinfeld 'ASSMAN' licence plate. Some of these come from a single guide, so treat them as reported.

lead: Sab dost saath khelna chahte hain, lekin GTA 6 Online kab aayega? Seedha jawab: abhi kisi ko official taur par nahi pata.
sections: Rockstar ne kya kaha
Date ke baare mein kuch nahi. GTA 6 19 November 2026 ko sirf single-player mein launch hua, online mode ke baghair.
'Story khatam karna zaroori' - jhoot
Viral post ke mutabiq online khelne ke liye 100% story zaroori hai. Mashable ke mutabiq ye ek satirical (mazaq wale) account se aaya. Rockstar ne aisi koi shart nahi batayi.
2027 kahan se aaya
Twitch ke CEO Dan Clancy ne kaha ke unhein agle saal multiplayer ki ummeed hai. Ye unka andaza hai, Rockstar ka announcement nahi.
Purana GTA Online
Take-Two ke mutabiq GTA 5 wala GTA Online chalta rahega, band nahi ho raha.
Tab tak
Story aaram se khelein: mission walkthrough, cheats aur paise kamane ke tareeqe.

title: GTA 6 Naye Players ke Liye 6 Zaroori Tips (Paise Na Ganwayein) - Urdu/Hindi
seo: GTA 6 Naye Players ke Liye 6 Tips (Urdu)
desc: GTA 6 shuru kar rahe hain? Ye 6 tips aapka paisa aur waqt bachaayengi: cash bank mein rakhein, maal jaldi bechein, look badlein, gaari bachaayein aur zyada.
lead: GTA 6 mein naye players aksar yehi galtiyan karte hain aur mehnat ka paisa kho dete hain. Ye 6 tips pehle parh lein.
sections: 1. Paisa bank mein rakhein
Jeb ka cash wasted ya busted hone par kho sakta hai. ATM aur BuckMe app aksar istemal karein, khaas taur par bare job se pehle.
2. Marne se pehle bechein
Chori ke jewels aur drugs fence par bech kar hi paisa bante hain. Pehle police se bachein; raste mein pakde gaye to poora bag gaya.
3. Apna look badlein
Ski mask, chashma ya topi heat kam karne mein madad karti hai. Getaway gaari tayyar rakhein aur search zone se jaldi niklein.
4. Gaari ko damage na karein
Damage hone se buyers kam paisa dete hain. Chori ki gaari mein tracker check karein.
5. Dono characters istemal karein
Zyada tar jobs Jason ya Lucia dono se hote hain, aur partner duffel bags uthane mein madad karta hai.
6. Stores ko restock hone dein
Ek hi store ko jaldi jaldi lootne se kam paisa milta hai. Alag alag jagah jayein. Aur tips: hidden controls (English) aur paise kamane ki guide.

title: GTA 6 Ke Saare Missions: Chapters aur Missable Side Missions (Urdu/Hindi)
seo: GTA 6 Ke Saare Missions (Urdu Walkthrough)
desc: GTA 6 mein kitne missions hain? Prologue aur 5 chapters mein 119 missions, har chapter ka ilaqa, character aur miss hone wale side missions.
lead: GTA 6 ki story Prologue aur 5 chapters mein bati hui hai, takreeban 119 main missions. Yahan har chapter ka khulasa hai, bina story spoil kiye.
sections: Chapters ek nazar mein

Prologue (Leonida Penitentiary, Lucia): 1 mission. Chapter 1 (Leonida Keys, pehle Jason phir Lucia): 24 missions. Chapter 2 (Port Gellhorn, zyada tar Lucia): 18. Chapter 3 (Vice City, Jason aur Lucia): 32. Chapter 4 (Vice City, kai solo missions): 34. Chapter 5 (final chapter): 10.
⚠️ Ye side missions miss ho sakte hain

Chapter 1: 'Get Shirley's Rum' aur 'Steal the Scooter' Keys chhodne se pehle kar lein, warna khatam. Chapter 3: Yago ki street race ('Race Against Yago') time-limited hai. Chapter 4: Shayna wala 'This Is a Free Call From...' (sirf Lucia) bhi time-limited hai.
Zaroori side quests

Chapter 2 mein Billy ki 'Thrillbillies' questline (Mud Club se shuru), Bret ka 'Veteran Hunted' (sirf Jason) aur McKittrick Farm ki kahani. Chapter 4 mein 'That's Where The Money Is...' se bade bank vaults khulte hain.
Har mission ki video
112 missions ke alag pages hain jin mein poori gameplay video hai, jaise Gone Fishing. Saare missions tarteeb se: walkthrough.
Mission names ke baare mein
Missions ke naam aur tarteeb kai player guides se mila kar likhe gaye hain aur update ho sakte hain. Chapter 2 ke baad ke naam halka sa spoiler ho sakte hain.

title: GTA 6 Criminal Profile Kya Hai? Professional se Irredeemable Tak (Urdu/Hindi)
seo: GTA 6 Criminal Profile Kya Hai? (Urdu)
desc: GTA 6 Criminal Profile aapka crime style dekhta hai: 5 levels, Psycho kaise bante hain, Professional kaise rahein, Irredeemable permanent kyun.
lead: GTA 6 chupke se dekhta hai ke Jason aur Lucia crime kaise karte hain. Is ko Criminal Profile kehte hain. Ye Focus bonus deta hai aur zyada had se guzre to hamesha ke liye lock ho sakta hai.
sections: 5 levels

Professional (khamosh, bina maare), Hardened (pakde jaane par taaqat), Violent (police aur aam logon par hamla), Psycho (bila wajah tashaddud) aur Irredeemable (permanent lock). Kuch sites doosre level ko 'Aggressive' kehti hain.
Psycho ki taraf kya le jata hai

Police ko maarna, aam logon ko nuqsaan pohanchana (khaas kar bhaagte ya bebas logon ko), paaltu ya kamzor janwaron ko maarna aur bila wajah tabahi. Dhamki dena (jaise store clerk) aur self-defence shumar nahi hote.
Professional kaise rahein
Zaroorat na ho to violence na karein, nazar mein na aayein, non-lethal takedown istemal karein. Achhi khabar: Hardened, Violent aur Psycho se wapas aaya ja sakta hai.
Toota hua icon = aakhri warning
Agar Psycho icon mein crack aa jaye to ruk jayein. Iske baad Irredeemable hai, jo normal game mein wapas nahi aata aur dono characters par asar karta hai. Rampage se pehle manual save zaroor karein.
Iska faida
Har style alag tareeqe se Focus deta hai: khamosh players ko non-lethal takedowns par, violent players ko headshots par. English mein poori detail: Criminal Profile explained.

title: GTA 6 Ke Chupe Hue Controls aur Tricks (PS5 aur Xbox) - Urdu/Hindi
seo: GTA 6 Chupe Hue Controls (Urdu Guide)
desc: GTA 6 ke chupe controls: ulti gaari seedhi karna, kahin bhi baithna, vehicle menu, WAiNK scan, police se chhupna. PS5 aur Xbox buttons ke saath.
lead: GTA 6 ka control scheme bohat bara hai aur tutorial bohat kuch nahi batata. Ye sab se kaam ke chupe hue controls hain (default layout).
sections: Ulti gaari seedhi karein

Gaari ke side par jaa kar Square / X daba kar rakhein. Gaari bohat bhaari ho, stamina khatam ho ya dhalaan ho to fail ho sakta hai. Isi se kinare par khari boat ya jet ski paani mein dhakel sakte hain.
Kahin bhi baithein
Paidal Circle / B daba kar rakhein: ghaas ya ret par baith jayein ya deewar se tek lagayein. Halka sa dabaana crouch karta hai.
Vehicle menu aur WAiNK
Gaari mein D-pad Left daba kar rakhein: engine, hazard lights, trunk, windows. D-pad Up daba kar rakhein WAiNK app ke liye, phir R1 / RB se gaari scan karein: class, lock aur tracker pata chalta hai.
Police se chhupein
Gaari mein Circle / B daba kar rakhein to character neeche jhuk jata hai.
Mazay ke controls

Bhaagte hue X / A se gaari ke hood par slide. R1 / RB se ishaara, right stick dabaa kar logon par chillana, L2 / LT se seeti. Settings mein Classic layout purane GTA wale controls deta hai. English guide: hidden controls.

title: GTA 6 Ka Map Kitna Bara Hai? Leonida ke 6 Ilaqe (Urdu/Hindi)
seo: GTA 6 Ka Map Kitna Bara Hai? (Urdu)
desc: GTA 6 ka map Leonida Rockstar ka sab se bara map, GTA 5 se takreeban do guna. 6 ilaqe: Vice City, Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Kalaga.
lead: Leonida Rockstar ka ab tak ka sab se bara map hai. Lekin internet par square miles ke alag alag number milte hain. Yahan wo hai jo waqai pata hai.
sections: Rockstar ne kya kaha
Sirf muqabla: Leonida GTA 5 ke map se takreeban do guna, Red Dead Redemption 2 se takreeban teen guna, aur GTA 4, GTA 5 aur RDR2 ke maps ko mila kar takreeban utna.
Square miles alag kyun
Koi official square-mile number nahi. Andaze 32 se 59 square miles tak hain, is par depend ke GTA 5 ka size kitna maana gaya aur paani gina gaya ya nahi.
6 ilaqe
Vice City (bara shehar), Leonida Keys (jazeeray), Grassrivers (daldal), Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia aur Mount Kalaga. Vice City poora map nahi, balke poori Leonida state hai.
Poora map khoojein

title: GTA 6 Point of No Return: Do This Before the Tourist Trap Mission
seo: GTA 6 Point of No Return: Before Tourist Trap
desc: GTA 6's Chapter 1 point of no return is Tourist Trap ('Take Up Mattia's Offer'). Finish Shirley's jobs, protect your cash and make a manual save first.
lead: Chapter 1 ends with a mission that locks you out of the Leonida Keys for a long time, and players are losing side jobs, money and cars because nobody warned them. Here's what to do first. No story spoilers.
sections: Which mission is it?

Tourist Trap is the Chapter 1 point of no return. On the map it shows as 'Take Up Mattia's Offer' and it unlocks after the mission Recalibration. You still have free roam until you start it, so that's your last chance.
Finish Shirley's side jobs
Get Shirley's Rum and Steal the Scooter disappear for good once Tourist Trap starts. Do them first.
Protect your money (reported)

Guides report that Jason's checking balance is emptied when the chapter ends. Some say money moved into Family Savings is kept, so move or spend your cash before you go. This comes from early player guides, so treat it as reported.
Your car and upgrades (reported)
Several guides say personal vehicles and their upgrades, even Ultimate Edition cars, are lost in the run of missions Tourist Trap starts. Don't spend big on upgrades right before it.
Make a separate manual save
GTA 6 has no mission replay menu, so save in a separate slot before you select the mission. That save is your only way back to Chapter 1 free roam.
Plan the rest
See every chapter and the other missable side missions in our walkthrough, earn more first with the money guide, or read this in Roman Urdu.

title: GTA 6 Point of No Return: Tourist Trap Se Pehle Ye Zaroor Karein (Urdu/Hindi)
seo: GTA 6 Point of No Return (Urdu Guide)
desc: GTA 6 Chapter 1 ka point of no return Tourist Trap mission hai. Shirley ke jobs khatam karein, paisa bachaayein aur alag manual save zaroor banayein.
lead: Chapter 1 ke aakhir mein ek mission aapko Leonida Keys se lambe arse ke liye door kar deta hai. Bohat se players side jobs, paisa aur gaariyan kho rahe hain. Pehle ye kaam kar lein. Koi spoiler nahi.
sections: Kaunsa mission?
Tourist Trap. Map par ye 'Take Up Mattia's Offer' naam se dikhta hai aur Recalibration mission ke baad khulta hai. Shuru karne se pehle tak free roam hai, wahi aakhri mauqa hai.
Shirley ke jobs khatam karein
Get Shirley's Rum aur Steal the Scooter Tourist Trap shuru hote hi hamesha ke liye khatam ho jaate hain.
Paisa bachaayein (reported)
Guides ke mutabiq chapter khatam hone par Jason ka checking balance khaali ho jata hai. Kuch kehte hain Family Savings mein rakha paisa bach jata hai. Ye early player guides ki maloomat hai.
Gaari aur upgrades (reported)
Kai guides kehti hain ke personal gaariyan aur unke upgrades (Ultimate Edition wali bhi) is mission ke baad chali jaati hain. Is se pehle mehenge upgrades na karein.
Alag manual save banayein
GTA 6 mein mission replay menu nahi hai. Mission shuru karne se pehle alag slot mein save karein, wahi Chapter 1 mein wapas jaane ka rasta hai. English: point of no return.

title: Unofficial GTA 6 PC Port Shut Down: 3,000+ Repos Taken Down by Take-Two
seo: Unofficial GTA 6 PC Port Shut Down
desc: Take-Two filed a takedown against 'Leonida', an unofficial GTA 6 PC port, removing 3,007 GitHub repositories. There's still no playable or official PC version.
lead: If you saw videos of GTA 6 'running on PC' this week, that project is gone. Here's what happened and why you shouldn't download any 'GTA 6 PC' files.
sections: What happened

On 24 November 2026 Take-Two filed a DMCA takedown against Leonida, the biggest unofficial project trying to run the Xbox version of GTA 6 on Windows. GitHub removed 3,007 repositories (the original and its forks) and the project's Discord server was taken down too.
Why
Take-Two argued the project told users to 'bring your own files', which it says pointed to leaked game files. The developers say they didn't share the files themselves.
Is GTA 6 playable on PC?
No. There's still no playable PC version and no official PC release date. GTA 6 is out only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Some other fan recompilation projects reportedly still exist but run poorly.
⚠️ Don't download 'GTA 6 PC'
Any 'GTA 6 PC download', 'crack' or 'port' you find now is either a scam, malware, or leaked files that can get you into legal trouble. Never enter passwords or card details on those sites.

desc: Take-Two ne 'Leonida' naam ka ghair-official GTA 6 PC port band karwa diya aur GitHub se 3,007 repositories hata di gayin. Official PC version abhi nahi hai.

24 November 2026 ko Take-Two ne Leonida project ke khilaf DMCA takedown bheja. Ye GTA 6 ka Xbox version Windows par chalane ki koshish thi. GitHub ne 3,007 repositories hata di aur Discord server bhi band ho gaya.
Kyun
Take-Two ke mutabiq project users ko 'apni files laao' kehta tha, jo leak hui game files ki taraf ishaara tha.
Kya PC par chal sakta hai?
Nahi. Koi playable PC version nahi aur official PC release date bhi nahi. GTA 6 sirf PS5 aur Xbox Series X|S par hai.

Koi bhi 'GTA 6 PC download', 'crack' ya 'port' scam, virus ya leak files hain jin se qanooni masla bhi ho sakta hai. Wahan password ya card details kabhi na daalein. Taaza khabar: GTA 6 PC par kab aayega.

title: GTA 6 Missables: Every Side Mission You Can Miss (By Chapter)
seo: GTA 6 Missables: Every Missable by Chapter
desc: Every GTA 6 missable side mission by chapter: Shirley's jobs before Tourist Trap, Yago's race, Shayna's call, plus how to avoid losing them.
lead: GTA 6 has a few side missions that vanish for good if the story moves on. Here's every confirmed missable, chapter by chapter, so you don't lose any. No story spoilers.
sections: Chapter 1: before Tourist Trap
Get Shirley's Rum and Steal the Scooter disappear once you leave the Leonida Keys. Tourist Trap ('Take Up Mattia's Offer') is the point of no return. Full checklist: point of no return guide.
Chapter 2: optional questlines
Not reported as missable, but easy to forget: Billy's Thrillbillies (starts at the Mud Club), Bret's Veteran Hunted (Jason only) and the McKittrick Farm side story. See the Chapter 2 walkthrough.
Chapter 3: Yago's street race
Race Against Yago is time-limited, and Yago's race chain ends with 'Brother to Brother'. Do it as soon as it appears so you don't risk the rest of the chain. Chapter 3 walkthrough.
Chapter 4: Shayna's call
This Is a Free Call From... is a Lucia-only, time-limited pickup. Also don't skip That's Where The Money Is..., which unlocks the big bank vaults (up to $205,000 each). Chapter 4 walkthrough.
How to never miss anything
Keep a separate manual save before every chapter ends (there's no mission replay menu), answer phone-call pickups when they ring, and track progress with our free 100% tracker. Urdu: saare missions.
A note on accuracy
This list combines several player guides and is updated as more players finish the game.
